## Case session 14: ""

```{r}
hd_data <- hd_data |>
    mutate(
        ExAng = factor(ExAng,
            levels = c(0, 1),
            labels = c("no", "yes")
        ),
        HD = factor(HD,
            levels = c("No", "Yes"),
            labels = c("no", "yes")
        ),
        ChestPain = factor(ChestPain),
        Thal = factor(Thal),
        fasting_blood_glucose = factor(Fbs,
            levels = c(0, 1),
            labels = c("normal", "high")
        )
    )

hd_data |>
  ggplot(ggplot2::aes(Age, MaxHR, color = HD)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```
